vc_sentences: Casillas 77 and 93 (rows 22-23) Rounding: clarified that per-employee values stay in whole pesos and the nearest-1,000 rounding of ET art. 577 is applied once to the aggregated casilla total.

Queries to RA added on casillas 77, 93, 78, 94 and 144 (rows 22-25 and 39): non-resident position (rows 22 and 31-34), base U vs W and depuration cap, contingent and theoretical withholding, nature of WT 62151 retiree payments, country-code standard; Field Explanations of rows 22, 24 and 25 unchanged (decisions 6, 8 and 9 of 15 Oct 2026).

Casilla 93 (row 23) Field Explanation: added the wage-type sources (WT 2552, and WT 21330 where the WT 2552 line is a zero-value Non Cash item), the reconciliation to Base of Withholding column V, the all-runs-of-the-month rule and the open treatment points flagged for RA; evidence Sep-2026 Base of Withholding, Vertical G2N and Accumulated Report.

Casilla 144 (row 39) Field Explanation: specified that the country is the payee's tax-residence country (residence-certificate country for treaty claims), not Nationality, with normalisation of the HR address country; the country-code standard is left for RA confirmation.
9 section-header and separator cells stored as formulas (rendered as #NAME? in Excel) converted to plain text in: Formulario 350 Spec, Sample File. No content change.
